rootCause: P0 level-data bug: ALL 30 shipped levels were degenerate — sol==1 existed only on pre-shaded '#' wall cells, never on playable '.' cells, so the 'solution' required zero player shading (win only via incidental toggle triggering checkWin). eas-06 had ZERO playable cells => strictly unwinnable by any input (checkWin only fires on cell value change / hint). Fix: regenerated all 30 levels' sol+clue with a growth-based generator enforcing real tapa semantics (shaded set 4-connected, no 2x2 shaded block, clues = desc-sorted neighbor run lengths, sol==1 only on playable cells); kept id/tier/size/par.
